frozen_rail_yard.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: final production 2D game background panorama for LETZTE SCHICHT, a detailed post-apocalyptic industrial pixel-art side-view bunker defense game. Generate a single continuous wide panorama at 3072 × 1024 pixels, exact 3:1 aspect ratio.
Primary request: FROZEN RAIL YARD. A vast snowbound railway freight depot on a clear polar morning. Rows of abandoned dark freight wagons and one legible locomotive silhouette sit among orderly snowbound tracks. On the center-right, a distinctive broad curved brick engine roundhouse has many arched bay openings, thick snow on its roof, several roof sections caved in, and a handful of very small warm amber cabin windows. Delicate catenary gantries and sagging power cables create a restrained railway rhythm. Distant low ice-blue hills and a small pale morning sun at upper right; quiet clear frosty sky.
Style/medium: premium hand-authored industrial pixel art with crisp hard-edged deliberate square pixel clusters, visibly stepped silhouettes, consistent pixel density equivalent to a 1536 × 512 working canvas shown at 2×; atmospheric depth in three readable layers, finely considered structure and materials. Broad clean masses and sparing texture; no photorealism, painterly blending, excessive dithering or speckled noise. Cohesive with dark charcoal bunker interiors, pale concrete and amber work lights, while retaining this world's distinct cyan snow palette.
Composition: distant side view, all subjects belong to the background. Upper 30% mostly uncluttered pale cyan sky; recognizable roundhouse and train landmarks between y=28% and y=65%, especially center/right (left third will be covered by game bunker). Lower 30% is quiet horizontal fields of blue snow and distant rail lines with subdued contrast; no large foreground objects. Crisp readable at thumbnail size. No orange sunset. Clear shape hierarchy.
Palette: glacial cyan, soft pale blue snow, cool desaturated cobalt shadows, near-black blue rails, tiny amber windows.
Constraints: one uninterrupted full-bleed panorama; no panels, labels, text, logo, watermark, UI, border, bunker, rooms, humans, characters, gameplay platforms, foreground ground strip, close-up objects, snowflakes or falling precipitation. No baked-in moving steam, smoke, particle debris or turbulent clouds; atmosphere will be animated by the game. Do not imitate the generic ruined city skyline of other worlds.
frozen_rail_yard.visual_review: Distinct clear cyan polar morning; broad arched snowbound roundhouse centered to right, railway tracks and locomotive; no baked precipitation or smoke. Controlled texture reads cleanly at game scale.
animation_suggestions: Very light slow snow particles above the gameplay horizon
Subtle warm window pulse confined to roundhouse windows
Low opacity drifting cold haze above the rail yard
